title: Real-Life: Fire drill at work
situation: You work in an office building. You hear the following announcement over the speaker on Tuesday morning.
script:
Narrator: Attention, please. This is a fire drill. Please do not be alarmed.
Narrator: When you hear the alarm, leave your desk immediately and walk to the nearest staircase. Do not use the elevators.
Narrator: Once outside, gather in the parking lot behind the building, next to the blue sign.
Narrator: Staff members will check the names on the list, so please stay in your assigned area until you are told it is safe to go back inside.
Narrator: The drill will last about ten minutes. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation:
お知らせいたします。これは火災避難訓練です。驚かないでください。
警報が鳴ったら、すぐに机を離れ、いちばん近い階段まで歩いてください。エレベーターは使わないでください。
外に出たら、建物の裏の駐車場に集合してください。青い看板の横です。
職員が名簿で名前を確認しますので、建物に戻っていいと言われるまで、決められた場所にとどまってください。
訓練は約10分間です。ご協力をお願いします。

questions.question: What should you do when you hear the alarm?
choices: Call the building manager from your desk.
Finish the report on your computer first.
Gather in the cafeteria on the second floor.
Go down the nearest staircase right away.
questions.explanation: 「When you hear the alarm, leave your desk immediately and walk to the nearest staircase.」より、警報が鳴ったら机をすぐ離れ、いちばん近い階段で降りる。エレベーターは使わない。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Restaurant booking change
situation: You booked a table for four at a restaurant for this Saturday. Now one friend cannot come, so you call the restaurant to change the booking. You hear the following conversation.
script:
Woman: Thank you for calling Bella Cucina. How may I help you?
Man: I booked a table for four this Saturday at seven, but one of my friends can no longer come. We will be three people now.
Woman: Thank you for letting us know. Would you like to keep the same time?
Man: Actually, we would like to come at six thirty instead. Is that possible?
Woman: Yes, we can offer a table for three at six thirty. However, please confirm the change by phone before Friday noon, or the booking will be released.
Man: Friday noon. Got it. Thanks for your help.
Woman: You're welcome. We look forward to seeing you on Saturday.
translation:
女性:ベラ・クチーナにお電話いただきありがとうございます。ご用件を伺います。
男性:今週土曜の7時に4人で予約しましたが、友人の1人が来られなくなりました。今は3人になります。
女性:ご連絡ありがとうございます。同じ時間のままがよろしいでしょうか。
男性:実は、6時30分に変えたいのです。可能ですか。
女性:はい、6時30分に3名用のテーブルをご用意できます。ただし、金曜の正午までにお電話で変更を確認してください。確認がないと予約は取り消されます。
男性:金曜の正午ですね。わかりました。ありがとうございます。
女性:こちらこそ。土曜日にお会いできるのを楽しみにしております。

questions.question: How can you keep the new booking?
choices: Bring a fourth friend to the table at seven.
Phone the restaurant to confirm the change by Friday noon.
Pay the full price of the meal in advance.
Keep the booking at seven and cancel on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 「please confirm the change by phone before Friday noon, or the booking will be released」より、金曜の正午までに電話で変更を確認する。7時のままにする、友人を追加する、前払いするという内容は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Daycare pickup change
situation: Your son attends Sunnyside Daycare. You are on your way to work when you hear the following voicemail from the daycare.
script:
Narrator: Hello, this is Sunnyside Daycare with a message for parents.
Narrator: Today, the front gate will be closed because of a water pipe repair, so please do not use the front entrance.
Narrator: Children will be dismissed at the side door on Maple Street. That door will stay open until six thirty p.m., but only today.
Narrator: The usual pickup time is five thirty, but the teachers will be busy with a special activity, so please come after five forty-five.
Narrator: If you arrive by car, you can only park on the street, because the parking lot is being repaired.
Narrator: Please keep your phone on, in case the teachers need to reach you during the afternoon.
Narrator: Thank you for your understanding.
translation:
こんにちは。サニーサイド保育園からの保護者の皆様へのお知らせです。
今日は水道管の修理のため、正門を閉めています。正面の入り口はお使いにならないでください。
子どもたちは、メイプル通り側の横のドアから引き渡します。そのドアは、今日だけ午後6時30分まで開けています。
いつもの迎えの時間は5時30分ですが、先生たちは特別な活動で忙しいため、5時45分を過ぎてからお越しください。
車でお越しの場合は、駐車場が修理中のため、道路沿いにしか停められません。
午後は先生が連絡をとる場合がありますので、電話はつながるようにしておいてください。
ご理解をありがとうございます。

questions.question: Where and when should you collect your son today?
choices: Collect your son at the Maple Street side entrance after five forty-five.
Use the front entrance at five thirty p.m.
Park in the daycare lot and wait inside.
Pick him up at the Maple Street side door at five thirty.
questions.explanation: 「Children will be dismissed at the side door on Maple Street」と「please come after five forty-five」をつなぐ。正門は閉まっていて、先生が忙しい5時30分は避ける。駐車場は修理中なので、駐車して中で待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Driver's license renewal
situation: You are sixty-eight years old. Your driver's license expires in six days, and you have not renewed it yet. You call the licensing office and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for calling the State Licensing Office.
Narrator: Drivers under seventy-five may renew their license by mail, using the renewal form and a copy of their current license.
Narrator: Renewal forms must be postmarked at least ten days before the expiration date. Forms that arrive late cannot be accepted.
Narrator: Drivers who are seventy-five or older must renew in person and pass an eye test.
Narrator: If your license has already expired, you cannot renew by mail and must apply in person.
Narrator: If you need help filling in the form, a staff member can assist you at any of our offices during opening hours.
Narrator: Our offices are open on weekdays from nine a.m. to four p.m., except on public holidays.
translation:
州運転免許局にお電話いただきありがとうございます。
75歳未満の運転者は、更新書類と現在の免許証の写しを使って、郵送で更新できます。
更新書類は、有効期限の少なくとも10日前までに消印が押されている必要があります。遅れて届いた書類は受け付けられません。
75歳以上の運転者は、窓口で直接更新し、視力検査に合格しなければなりません。
すでに免許が切れている場合は、郵送での更新はできず、窓口で手続きする必要があります。
用紙の記入でお困りの場合は、開所時間中であればどの窓口でも職員がお手伝いします。
窓口は、祝日を除く平日の午前9時から午後4時まで開いています。

questions.question: How should you renew your license?
choices: Visit a licensing office in person before it expires.
Mail the renewal form and a copy of the license today.
Take an eye test at home and send the result by mail.
Renew online using the renewal form on the website.
questions.explanation: 「Renewal forms must be postmarked at least ten days before the expiration date.」と「expires in six days」をつなぐ。郵送の期限に間に合わないので、有効期限の前に窓口へ行く。視力検査は75歳以上の人の条件で、この人は対象外。

title: Real-Life: Stadium gate update
situation: You have a lower-section ticket for tonight's baseball game at Northfield Stadium. On the way there, you receive the following urgent message on your phone.
script:
Narrator: This is Northfield Stadium with an urgent update for tonight's game.
Narrator: Earlier, we announced that all fans should use the north gate. Please disregard that message, because the north gate is now blocked by equipment trucks.
Narrator: Lower-section fans were then asked to use the west gate, which opens at four thirty p.m. However, the west gate has now been closed for a safety check.
Narrator: Upper-section fans should use the east gate, as planned. The west gate will not reopen tonight, so lower-section fans should not wait for it.
Narrator: Lower-section fans may also enter through the east gate, since we have added extra staff there.
Narrator: Please keep your ticket ready, because staff will scan every ticket at the entrance.
Narrator: Please allow extra time for security checks, as the lines may be longer than usual.
Narrator: We apologize for the changes and thank you for your patience.
translation:
こちらはノースフィールド・スタジアムからの、今夜の試合に関する緊急のお知らせです。
先ほどは、全員が北ゲートを使うようにと案内しました。その連絡は無視してください。北ゲートは機材を運ぶトラックでふさがれています。
その後、内野席のお客様には西ゲートを使うよう案内しました。ところが、西ゲートは安全点検のため閉鎖されています。
外野席のお客様は、予定どおり東ゲートをご利用ください。西ゲートは今夜は再開しませんので、内野席のお客様はそこで待たないでください。
内野席のお客様も、東ゲートから入場できます。東ゲートには係員を増やしました。
チケットは入口ですべてスキャンしますので、すぐに出せるようにしておいてください。
セキュリティ検査の列は普段より長くなるかもしれませんので、余裕を持っておいでください。
変更でご迷惑をおかけして申し訳ありません。ご協力に感謝します。

questions.question: Which gate should you use with your lower-section ticket?
choices: Use the north gate, as announced first.
Proceed through the east gate, which lower-section fans may also use.
Wait at the west gate until it reopens at four thirty.
Head to the main gate near the parking lot.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Lower-section fans may also enter through the east gate」。北ゲートは機材で使えず、西ゲートは安全点検で閉鎖され、今夜は再開しないと訂正されている。午後4時30分の西ゲートを待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Zoo talk change
situation: You are visiting Westbridge Zoo today and want to see the penguins. You hear the following announcement at the zoo entrance.
script:
Narrator: Good morning, visitors. This is Westbridge Zoo with an update for today.
Narrator: The penguin feeding show scheduled for two p.m. has been canceled because our keeper is ill.
Narrator: Instead, a short talk about penguins will take place at three p.m. at the North Pond.
Narrator: The talk will be given outdoors, so please dress warmly if the weather is cold.
Narrator: The keepers will also answer questions after the talk, so please stay nearby if you are curious.
Narrator: Thank you for understanding, and enjoy the rest of your visit.
translation:
おはようございます。ご来園のお客様へお知らせします。ウェストブリッジ動物園です。
午後2時に予定していたペンギンの餌やりショーは、飼育係の体調不良のため中止になりました。
その代わりに、午後3時から北の池のそばで、ペンギンについての短い話があります。
話は屋外で行いますので、寒い場合は暖かい服装でお越しください。
お話の後、飼育係が質問にお答えします。興味があれば、近くでお待ちください。
ご理解ありがとうございます。残りの時間も楽しんでください。

questions.question: Where should you go at three p.m. today?
choices: Head to the North Pond for the penguin talk.
Ride the train around the zoo at noon.
Visit the gift shop before closing time.
Wait at the main gate until the zoo closes.
questions.explanation: 「a short talk about penguins will take place at three p.m. at the North Pond」より、午後3時に北の池で行われるペンギンの話を聞きに行く。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Mobile plan cancellation
situation: You want to cancel your mobile phone plan because you are moving abroad next week. You cannot visit a store, so you call the phone company and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for calling Starline Mobile.
Narrator: To cancel a contract, you must visit one of our stores or use the cancellation form on our website.
Narrator: Cancellations made by phone are not accepted, so please do not wait on the line for a cancellation agent.
Narrator: If you cancel before the end of the month, you will not be charged for the next month.
Narrator: Please return your phone and SIM card to any store within two weeks of cancellation.
Narrator: Please check that all your bills are paid, because any unpaid balance must be settled before canceling.
Narrator: Our stores are open from ten a.m. to eight p.m., every day.
translation:
スタートライン・モバイルにお電話いただきありがとうございます。
契約を解約するには、店舗にお越しいただくか、ウェブサイトの解約フォームをご利用いただく必要があります。
電話での解約は受け付けていませんので、解約担当者におつなぎするまでお待ちいただく必要はありません。
月末より前に解約された場合は、翌月分の料金はかかりません。
解約から2週間以内に、お近くの店舗へ携帯電話とSIMカードをご返却ください。
解約の前に、未払いの料金があればすべてお支払いください。
店舗は毎日、午前10時から午後8時まで営業しています。

questions.question: How can you cancel the plan from abroad?
choices: Call the cancellation agent and wait on the line.
Send your SIM card to the company by mail.
Use the online cancellation form before the month ends.
Visit a store after the next month begins.
questions.explanation: 「use the cancellation form on our website」と「If you cancel before the end of the month, you will not be charged for the next month」より、月末までにウェブサイトの解約フォームから解約する。電話での解約は受け付けていないので、電話で待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Car insurance claim
situation: You had a small accident in a parking lot yesterday. Your car bumper is cracked, and you need to file a claim with your insurance company. You hear the following conversation with the claims agent.
script:
Woman: Northstar Insurance, how can I help you?
Man: I had a small accident yesterday, and my bumper is cracked.
Woman: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you take photos of the damage before the car was moved?
Man: Yes, I did, but my phone is broken, so I can't send them by email.
Woman: Our claim form needs the photos. You can upload them through our app, or print them and bring them to any of our offices.
Man: The app is not working on my phone, and the closest office is an hour away.
Woman: In that case, you can mail the printed photos to our claims center. But if they arrive after Friday, the claim may be delayed beyond the coverage period.
translation:
女性:ノースター保険です。ご用件を伺います。
男性:昨日、小さな事故を起こしました。私の車のバンパーにひびが入りました。
女性:それは大変でしたね。車を動かす前に、損傷の写真は撮られましたか。
男性:撮りましたが、スマートフォンが壊れていて、メールでは送れません。
女性:保険金の請求書には写真が必要です。アプリからアップロードするか、印刷してどの営業所へお持ちいただいても結構です。
男性:アプリは私のスマートフォンでは動きませんし、いちばん近い営業所まで車で1時間かかります。
女性:それでしたら、印刷した写真を請求センターへ郵送してください。ただし金曜日より後に届くと、補償の期間を過ぎてしまうおそれがあります。

questions.question: What should the man do to get the claim processed in time?
choices: Upload the photos through the app on his phone.
Visit the nearest office and hand in the photos.
Post the printed pictures to the claims department by Friday.
Send the photos by email tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 「you can mail the printed photos to our claims center」と「if they arrive after Friday, the claim may be delayed」をつなぐ。アプリは使えず、営業所は遠く、メールは使えないので、印刷した写真を金曜までに郵送する。

title: Real-Life: Job center interview
situation: You are a job seeker with an interview at Crown Logistics on Tuesday, but you are also registered for a training session at the job center at the same time. You call the job center and hear the following conversation.
script:
Woman: Thank you for calling Westbrook Job Center. How may I help you?
Man: I have a job interview at Crown Logistics on Tuesday at ten a.m., but I'm also scheduled for a training session at the same time.
Woman: The training is required for everyone registered this month. However, people who have already completed the safety course are exempt.
Man: I finished that course last month. Do I need to do anything to be excused?
Woman: Yes. You must give us a copy of your certificate by Monday, because we can't check it once the training begins.
Man: I see. So I would miss the training, but I could still go to the interview?
Woman: Exactly. The interview is at Crown Logistics, not here, so you won't need to come to the center on Tuesday.
translation:
女性:ウェストブルック就労支援センターにお電話いただきありがとうございます。ご用件を伺います。
男性:火曜の午前10時にクラウン・ロジスティクスで面接があるのですが、同じ時間に研修の予定も入っています。
女性:研修は今月登録された方全員に必要です。ただし、安全講習をすでに修了している方は免除されます。
男性:その講習は先月修了しました。免除してもらうには何か必要ですか。
女性:はい。研修が始まってからでは確認できませんので、修了証の写しを月曜日までにお渡しください。
男性:わかりました。つまり、研修には出られないけれど、面接には行けるということですね。
女性:そのとおりです。面接はこちらではなくクラウン・ロジスティクスで行われますので、火曜日にセンターへお越しいただく必要はありません。

questions.question: Which step will let you attend the interview on Tuesday?
choices: Attend the training session at the job center on Tuesday.
Go to Crown Logistics after the training is finished.
Retake the safety course before the interview.
Provide proof of your completed safety course to the center by Monday.
questions.explanation: 「people who have already completed the safety course are exempt」と「You must give us a copy of your certificate by Monday」をつなぐ。修了証の写しを月曜までに出せば研修は免除され、面接に行ける。火曜の研修に出る、講習を受け直すという内容は誤り。

title: Real-Life: Elevator repair and moving
situation: You need to move a heavy piano out of your apartment this week. You hear the following announcement from the building manager.
script:
Narrator: Good evening, residents. This is the building manager with an update about the elevator repairs.
Narrator: Earlier, we said the passenger elevators would be closed on Thursday only. Please disregard that information.
Narrator: The freight elevator, which was supposed to be available on Thursday afternoon, is now out of service because of a motor problem.
Narrator: The repair company has postponed its visit, so the freight elevator will stay closed until next week.
Narrator: Passenger elevators will run as usual, but they may not be used to move large furniture or pianos.
Narrator: For heavy items, the rear ramp can be used on Friday morning, when a staff member will be present to supervise.
Narrator: Please do not leave the piano in the hallway at any time, because it could block the emergency exit.
Narrator: Please reserve the ramp at the front desk by Wednesday evening.
translation:
こんばんは、住人の皆様。建物の管理人です。エレベーターの修理についてお知らせします。
先ほどは、客用エレベーターは木曜だけ止まると案内しました。その情報は無視してください。
木曜の午後に使えるはずだった荷物用エレベーターは、モーターの故障で今は使えません。
修理業者が訪問を延期したため、荷物用エレベーターは来週まで止まったままです。
客用エレベーターはいつもどおり動きますが、大きな家具やピアノを運ぶために使うことはできません。
重い物は、金曜の午前中に裏のスロープを使えます。そのときは職員が立ち会って見守ります。
ピアノを廊下に置いたままにしないでください。非常口をふさぐおそれがあります。
スロープは水曜日の夕方までに、正面の受付でご予約ください。

questions.question: How should you move your piano?
choices: Use the freight elevator on Thursday afternoon.
Arrange to use the rear ramp on Friday morning.
Move the piano in a passenger elevator this week.
Leave the piano in the hallway until the freight elevator is fixed.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the rear ramp can be used on Friday morning」。木曜の荷物用エレベーターは故障で使えず、客用エレベーターはピアノを運ぶのに使えないと訂正されている。水曜の夕方までに受付で予約する必要がある。
